messages:
Alex (Finance): heads up — found ~USD 18,400 in untagged west-gpu charges from 03:00-06:00 UTC. billing close is EOD PST, need quick allocation?
Sam (Eng-ML): ack. can you paste the cost ids? I'll run a query and try to attribute.
Alex (Finance): cost_ids: `chg_wn_20260323_*` (see export). Rough breakdown shows 12k from notebooks, 6.4k from prod pools.
Maya (Platform): @Alex (Finance) @Sam (Eng-ML) I can check autoscale labels — sometimes pool tags drop when nodes recycle. I'll tail the autoscaler logs.
Nora (Billing): FYI: we can do a one-time allocation override but need approved owner + ticket. who's requesting owner for the notebook spend?
Sam (Eng-ML): likely Team Search — pinging @jordan-search offline. For now I can map notebook instance tags to team via `SELECT team FROM inventory WHERE instance_id IN (...)` ; will push results here.
chargebot: ticket created: CHG-1248 — temp allocation to `platform:dev` pending owner confirmation. Details: https://redwood.atlassian.com/CHG-1248
Alex (Finance): thx @chargebot. @Nora (Billing) can you apply manual allocation for that ticket once we confirm team? We need it before today's close.
Nora (Billing): yes, I can apply manual allocation but will leave a note for retro if owner claims different team. Also need cost center code.
Sam (Eng-ML): query results: `team=search` matches 78% of notebook ids, rest are `playground`. I'll attach CSV in the ticket.
Maya (Platform): autoscaler logs show a bug where `env=play` tag dropped on preemptible nodes between 02:52-03:10 — filing infra PR to prevent: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/412
Alex (Finance): plan: Nora to apply temp allocation to search (cost center 4102) with note; Sam to update ticket with mapping and notify Jordan; Maya to merge fix; Alex to confirm after close. :thumbsup:
Nora (Billing): started manual allocation, added note. Will send screenshot when done.
Sam (Eng-ML): will @jordan-search and cc finance. done.
Alex (Finance): thanks all — please keep replies minimal unless blocker. I'll close thread after billing cutoff.
